    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget

  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}

content_full:
import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

export ModelData (allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget exists_support)

attribute [simp] allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget

theorem tSetForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {x₁ x₂ : TSet α}
    (h : x₁ᵁ = x₂ᵁ) : x₁ = x₂ :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_injective' h

theorem tSetForget_surjective [ModelData ⊥] (x : StrSet ⊥) :
    ∃ y : TSet ⊥, yᵁ = x :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' rfl x

theorem allPermForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α}
    (h : ρ₁ᵁ = ρ₂ᵁ) : ρ₁ = ρ₂ :=
  ModelData.allPermForget_injective' h

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_inv {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρ⁻¹ᵁ = ρᵁ⁻¹ := by
  rw [eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one, ← allPermForget_mul, inv_mul_cancel, allPermForget_one]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_npow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℕ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, allPermForget_one]
  | succ n h => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, allPermForget_mul, h]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_zpow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℤ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n using Int.negInduction with
  | nat n => rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_npow]
  | neg h' n => simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_inv, allPermForget_npow]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρ₁ᵁ • S = ρ₂ᵁ • S) :
    ρ₁ • x = ρ₂ • x := by
  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_

content_full:
import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

export ModelData (allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget exists_support)

attribute [simp] allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget

theorem tSetForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {x₁ x₂ : TSet α}
    (h : x₁ᵁ = x₂ᵁ) : x₁ = x₂ :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_injective' h

theorem tSetForget_surjective [ModelData ⊥] (x : StrSet ⊥) :
    ∃ y : TSet ⊥, yᵁ = x :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' rfl x

theorem allPermForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α}
    (h : ρ₁ᵁ = ρ₂ᵁ) : ρ₁ = ρ₂ :=
  ModelData.allPermForget_injective' h

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_inv {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρ⁻¹ᵁ = ρᵁ⁻¹ := by
  rw [eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one, ← allPermForget_mul, inv_mul_cancel, allPermForget_one]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_npow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℕ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, allPermForget_one]
  | succ n h => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, allPermForget_mul, h]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_zpow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℤ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n using Int.negInduction with
  | nat n => rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_npow]
  | neg h' n => simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_inv, allPermForget_npow]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρ₁ᵁ • S = ρ₂ᵁ • S) :
    ρ₁ • x = ρ₂ • x := by
  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_mul, mul_smul, allPermForget_inv, inv_smul_eq_iff]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_of_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρᵁ • S = S) :
    ρ • x = x := by
  have := smul_eq_smul (ρ₁ := ρ) (ρ₂ := 1) h ?_
  · rwa [one_smul] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_one, one_smul]

theorem Support.Supports.smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) (ρ : AllPerm α) :
    (ρᵁ • S).Supports (ρ • x) := by
  constructor
  · intro σ hσ
    rw [smul_smul, ← allPermForget_mul] at hσ
    have := h.smul_eq_smul hσ
    rwa [mul_smul] at this
  · intro h'
    rw [smul_nearLitters, h.nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot h']
    rfl

instance {β α : TypeIndex} [ModelData β] [ModelData α] : TypedMem (TSet β) (TSet α) β α where
  typedMem h y x := yᵁ ∈[h] xᵁ

theorem TSet.forget_mem_forget {β α : TypeIndex} [ModelData β] [ModelData α] (h : β < α)
    {x : TSet β} {y : TSet α} :
    xᵁ ∈[h] yᵁ ↔ x ∈[h] y :=
  Iff.rfl

structure Tangle (α : TypeIndex) [ModelData α] where
  set : TSet α
  support : Support α
  support_supports : support.Supports set

content_full:
import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}

  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this

import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

export ModelData (allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget exists_support)

attribute [simp] allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget

theorem tSetForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {x₁ x₂ : TSet α}
    (h : x₁ᵁ = x₂ᵁ) : x₁ = x₂ :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_injective' h

theorem tSetForget_surjective [ModelData ⊥] (x : StrSet ⊥) :
    ∃ y : TSet ⊥, yᵁ = x :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' rfl x

theorem allPermForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α}
    (h : ρ₁ᵁ = ρ₂ᵁ) : ρ₁ = ρ₂ :=
  ModelData.allPermForget_injective' h

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_inv {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρ⁻¹ᵁ = ρᵁ⁻¹ := by
  rw [eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one, ← allPermForget_mul, inv_mul_cancel, allPermForget_one]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_npow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℕ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, allPermForget_one]
  | succ n h => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, allPermForget_mul, h]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_zpow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℤ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n using Int.negInduction with
  | nat n => rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_npow]
  | neg h' n => simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_inv, allPermForget_npow]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρ₁ᵁ • S = ρ₂ᵁ • S) :
    ρ₁ • x = ρ₂ • x := by
  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_mul, mul_smul, allPermForget_inv, inv_smul_eq_iff]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_of_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρᵁ • S = S) :
    ρ • x = x := by
  have := smul_eq_smul (ρ₁ := ρ) (ρ₂ := 1) h ?_
  · rwa [one_smul] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_one, one_smul]

theorem Support.Supports.smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) (ρ : AllPerm α) :
    (ρᵁ • S).Supports (ρ • x) := by
  constructor
  · intro σ hσ
    rw [smul_smul, ← allPermForget_mul] at hσ
    have := h.smul_eq_smul hσ
    rwa [mul_smul] at this
  · intro h'
    rw [smul_nearLitters, h.nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot h']
    rfl

instance {β α : TypeIndex} [ModelData β] [ModelData α] : TypedMem (TSet β) (TSet α) β α where
  typedMem h y x := yᵁ ∈[h] xᵁ

theorem TSet.forget_mem_forget {β α : TypeIndex} [ModelData β] [ModelData α] (h : β < α)
    {x : TSet β} {y : TSet α} :
    xᵁ ∈[h] yᵁ ↔ x ∈[h] y :=
  Iff.rfl

import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}

  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this

import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

export ModelData (allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget exists_support)

attribute [simp] allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget

theorem tSetForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {x₁ x₂ : TSet α}
    (h : x₁ᵁ = x₂ᵁ) : x₁ = x₂ :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_injective' h

theorem tSetForget_surjective [ModelData ⊥] (x : StrSet ⊥) :
    ∃ y : TSet ⊥, yᵁ = x :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' rfl x

theorem allPermForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α}
    (h : ρ₁ᵁ = ρ₂ᵁ) : ρ₁ = ρ₂ :=
  ModelData.allPermForget_injective' h

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_inv {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρ⁻¹ᵁ = ρᵁ⁻¹ := by
  rw [eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one, ← allPermForget_mul, inv_mul_cancel, allPermForget_one]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_npow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℕ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, allPermForget_one]
  | succ n h => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, allPermForget_mul, h]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_zpow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℤ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n using Int.negInduction with
  | nat n => rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_npow]
  | neg h' n => simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_inv, allPermForget_npow]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρ₁ᵁ • S = ρ₂ᵁ • S) :
    ρ₁ • x = ρ₂ • x := by
  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_mul, mul_smul, allPermForget_inv, inv_smul_eq_iff]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_of_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρᵁ • S = S) :
    ρ • x = x := by
  have := smul_eq_smul (ρ₁ := ρ) (ρ₂ := 1) h ?_
  · rwa [one_smul] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_one, one_smul]

theorem Support.Supports.smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) (ρ : AllPerm α) :
    (ρᵁ • S).Supports (ρ • x) := by
  constructor
  · intro σ hσ
    rw [smul_smul, ← allPermForget_mul] at hσ
    have := h.smul_eq_smul hσ
    rwa [mul_smul] at this
  · intro h'
    rw [smul_nearLitters, h.nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot h']
    rfl

instance {β α : TypeIndex} [ModelData β] [ModelData α] : TypedMem (TSet β) (TSet α) β α where
  typedMem h y x := yᵁ ∈[h] xᵁ

theorem TSet.forget_mem_forget {β α : TypeIndex} [ModelData β] [ModelData α] (h : β < α)
    {x : TSet β} {y : TSet α} :
    xᵁ ∈[h] yᵁ ↔ x ∈[h] y :=
  Iff.rfl

  set : TSet α

  support_supports : support.Supports set

import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

export ModelData (allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget exists_support)

attribute [simp] allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget

theorem tSetForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {x₁ x₂ : TSet α}
    (h : x₁ᵁ = x₂ᵁ) : x₁ = x₂ :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_injective' h

theorem tSetForget_surjective [ModelData ⊥] (x : StrSet ⊥) :
    ∃ y : TSet ⊥, yᵁ = x :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' rfl x

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_npow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℕ) :

  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, allPermForget_one]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρ₁ᵁ • S = ρ₂ᵁ • S) :
    ρ₁ • x = ρ₂ • x := by
  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_mul, mul_smul, allPermForget_inv, inv_smul_eq_iff]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_of_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρᵁ • S = S) :
    ρ • x = x := by
  have := smul_eq_smul (ρ₁ := ρ) (ρ₂ := 1) h ?_

  · rwa [allPermForget_one, one_smul]

    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) (ρ : AllPerm α) :

  constructor
  · intro σ hσ
    rw [smul_smul, ← allPermForget_mul] at hσ

    rwa [mul_smul] at this
  · intro h'
    rw [smul_nearLitters, h.nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot h']
    rfl

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

attribute [simp] allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget

theorem tSetForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {x₁ x₂ : TSet α}
    (h : x₁ᵁ = x₂ᵁ) : x₁ = x₂ :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_injective' h

theorem tSetForget_surjective [ModelData ⊥] (x : StrSet ⊥) :
    ∃ y : TSet ⊥, yᵁ = x :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' rfl x

theorem allPermForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α}
    (h : ρ₁ᵁ = ρ₂ᵁ) : ρ₁ = ρ₂ :=
  ModelData.allPermForget_injective' h

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_inv {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρ⁻¹ᵁ = ρᵁ⁻¹ := by
  rw [eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one, ← allPermForget_mul, inv_mul_cancel, allPermForget_one]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_npow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℕ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, allPermForget_one]
  | succ n h => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, allPermForget_mul, h]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_zpow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℤ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n using Int.negInduction with
  | nat n => rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_npow]
  | neg h' n => simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_inv, allPermForget_npow]

    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρ₁ᵁ • S = ρ₂ᵁ • S) :
    ρ₁ • x = ρ₂ • x := by
  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_mul, mul_smul, allPermForget_inv, inv_smul_eq_iff]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_of_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρᵁ • S = S) :
    ρ • x = x := by
  have := smul_eq_smul (ρ₁ := ρ) (ρ₂ := 1) h ?_
  · rwa [one_smul] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_one, one_smul]

theorem Support.Supports.smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) (ρ : AllPerm α) :
    (ρᵁ • S).Supports (ρ • x) := by
  constructor
  · intro σ hσ
    rw [smul_smul, ← allPermForget_mul] at hσ
    have := h.smul_eq_smul hσ
    rwa [mul_smul] at this
  · intro h'
    rw [smul_nearLitters, h.nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot h']
    rfl

instance {β α : TypeIndex} [ModelData β] [ModelData α] : TypedMem (TSet β) (TSet α) β α where
  typedMem h y x := by exact?

import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

export ModelData (allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget exists_support)

attribute [simp] allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget

theorem tSetForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {x₁ x₂ : TSet α}
    (h : x₁ᵁ = x₂ᵁ) : x₁ = x₂ :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_injective' h

theorem tSetForget_surjective [ModelData ⊥] (x : StrSet ⊥) :
    ∃ y : TSet ⊥, yᵁ = x :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' rfl x

theorem allPermForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α}
    (h : ρ₁ᵁ = ρ₂ᵁ) : ρ₁ = ρ₂ :=
  ModelData.allPermForget_injective' h

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_inv {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρ⁻¹ᵁ = ρᵁ⁻¹ := by
  rw [eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one, ← allPermForget_mul, inv_mul_cancel, allPermForget_one]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_npow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℕ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, allPermForget_one]
  | succ n h => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, allPermForget_mul, h]

@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_zpow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℤ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n := by
  induction n using Int.negInduction with
  | nat n => rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_npow]
  | neg h' n => simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_inv, allPermForget_npow]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρ₁ᵁ • S = ρ₂ᵁ • S) :
    ρ₁ • x = ρ₂ • x := by
  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_mul, mul_smul, allPermForget_inv, inv_smul_eq_iff]

theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_of_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρᵁ • S = S) :
    ρ • x = x := by
  have := smul_eq_smul (ρ₁ := ρ) (ρ₂ := 1) h ?_
  · rwa [one_smul] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_one, one_smul]

theorem Support.Supports.smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) (ρ : AllPerm α) :
    (ρᵁ • S).Supports (ρ • x) := by
  constructor
  · intro σ hσ
    rw [smul_smul, ← allPermForget_mul] at hσ
    have := h.smul_eq_smul hσ
    rwa [mul_smul] at this
  · intro h'
    rw [smul_nearLitters, h.nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot h']
    rfl

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ

universe u

namespace ConNF

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/

  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]

  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN

  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]

    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ

    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget

    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN

  · exact hT

  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ

content_full:
import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

export ModelData (allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget exists_support)

attribute [simp] allPermForget_one allPermForget_mul smul_forget

theorem tSetForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {x₁ x₂ : TSet α}
    (h : x₁ᵁ = x₂ᵁ) : x₁ = x₂ :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_injective' h

theorem tSetForget_surjective [ModelData ⊥] (x : StrSet ⊥) :
    ∃ y : TSet ⊥, yᵁ = x :=
  ModelData.tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' rfl x

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

import ConNF.Levels.StrSet
import ConNF.ModelData.Support

/-!
# Model data

In this file, we define what model data at a type index means.

## Main declarations

* `ConNF.ModelData`: The type of model data at a given type index.
-/

universe u

open Cardinal

namespace ConNF

variable [Params.{u}]

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

class ModelData (α : TypeIndex) extends PreModelData α where
  tSetForget_injective' : Function.Injective tSetForget
  tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' : α = ⊥ → Function.Surjective tSetForget
  allPermForget_injective' : Function.Injective allPermForget
  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1
  allPermForget_mul (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm) : (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
  smul_forget (ρ : AllPerm) (x : TSet) : (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
  exists_support (x : TSet) : ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x

universe u

open Cardinal

/-- The same as `ModelData` but without the propositions. -/
class PreModelData (α : TypeIndex) where
  TSet : Type u
  AllPerm : Type u
  [allPermGroup : Group AllPerm]
  [allAction : MulAction AllPerm TSet]
  tSetForget : TSet → StrSet α
  allPermForget : AllPerm → StrPerm α

export PreModelData (TSet AllPerm)

attribute [instance] PreModelData.allPermGroup PreModelData.allAction

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (TSet α) (StrSet α) where
  superU := PreModelData.tSetForget

instance {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] : SuperU (AllPerm α) (StrPerm α) where
  superU := PreModelData.allPermForget

structure Support.Supports {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X) : Prop where
  supports (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • x = x
  nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot : α = ⊥ → Sᴺ = .empty

theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x := by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

  allPermForget_one : (1 : AllPerm)ᵁ = 1

    π • S = S ↔ ∀ A, (∀ a ∈ (S ⇘. A)ᴬ, π A • a = a) ∧ (∀ N ∈ (S ⇘. A)ᴺ, π A • N = N) := by

  simp only [one_smul, Tree.one_apply] at this
